name: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Rinse toor dal and simmer with 800 ml water and turmeric for 35–45 minutes until completely soft. Mash lightly.
Rinse rice, dice carrot and beans and chop tomato. Cook rice with vegetables and 750 ml water in a separate pot for 20 minutes until soft.
Mix tamarind paste, spice powder and jaggery with remaining 150 ml water and simmer separately for 5 minutes.
Combine cooked rice and vegetables, mashed dal and the tamarind-spice mixture. Add salt and simmer for 8–10 minutes, stirring the base.
Heat ghee, toast cashews, pop mustard seeds and add curry leaves. Pour the tempering into the pot.
Adjust with hot water to a soft, flowing consistency and serve hot. The dish should be looser than pulao.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
